Asset Repair
fields.description: How a repair gets its parts.

fields.label: Use Material Requests for repair parts
fields.description:
Turn this on if the workshop must ask for repair parts instead of taking them from the store. The repair gets a Materials list. From it you raise a Material Request to get parts from the store or to buy parts and services, and someone approves it first. The parts issued and the supplier bills make up the repair cost.

Leave it off to use ERPNext's normal Asset Repair, where the Stock Items are taken from the store automatically when the repair is submitted.
